meta.title: Ambient Gallery (dsh-ambient-gallery)
meta.description: A string of photographs hung behind the main panel — each a different size, each at its own angle, all with room to breathe, kept to the middle 20-80% of the width. Five photographs ship with the plugin and are pinched onto the wall on first run; every photo rotates up to twenty images, your own local pictures go on with a click, and one of them can quietly play a local video until a single shortcut asks it to step back and join the rotation.
